status.main_product: Drone survey services and aerial data analytics
status.scope_reason: The company designs, manufactures, and deploys its own proprietary surveying drones and cloud analytics software to provide end-to-end aerial mapping solutions.
status.evidence: According to company profiles from Tracxn and official press releases from 2024 to 2026, Aereo (operating under Aarav Unmanned Systems Private Limited) is an active commercial drone surveying and decision intelligence platform based in Bangalore.

claims.claim: The company reports building commercial-grade, proprietary survey-grade drones with up to 13 kg payload capability, which support the integration of professional-quality cameras and LiDAR sensors.

Aero's engineering team performs the internal hardware integration and quality control of flight controllers, IMU/GNSS positioning sensors, and varying payload options to bridge prototypes to production.
claims.note: internal hardware integration and quality control workflow to bridge prototypes to production

claims.claim: The company reports its proprietary web-based SaaS platform, Aereo Cloud, converts raw drone data into native engineering outputs such as point clouds, Digital Elevation Models, and 2D/3D maps. The platform features automated AI-powered algorithms to automatically detect stockpile boundaries from georeferenced drone data and deliver volumetric analytics.

In October 2025, the company announced a global strategic partnership integrating Aereo Cloud with Datamine's mining software suite to enable real-time plan-versus-actual reconciliation and connect survey, planning, and operational workflows.

The company reports providing high-resolution models with centimeter-level accuracy and drone mapping/volumetric analytics solutions that deliver better accuracy, improved operational efficiency, and faster decision-making for clients such as Hindalco.

Hindalco's Vice President of Mining verified that they regularly use Aereo's drone solutions for volumetric assessments on a weekly basis at their mines and captive power plants, noting that the analytics have significantly improved process accuracy.
The company reported utilizing state-of-the-art purpose-built drones, including the Aereo INP, which is a DGCA type-certified micro drone weighing 3.67 kg designed for precise surveys.

The company reports that its survey workflows integrate high-density LiDAR sensors running SLAM algorithms for GPS-denied environments alongside professional-quality mapping cameras, and its indigenous survey-grade PPK platforms are deployed across major open-cast mines for Coal India Limited.
claims.note: high-density LiDAR sensors running SLAM algorithms for GPS-denied environments alongside professional-quality mapping cameras

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: Aereo holds 15 patents related to its technology moat across hardware, software, and services.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: Aereo signed an MoU in early 2026 with TEXMiN at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to establish the TEXMiN-Aereo Aerial Intelligence in Mining (TAaIM) Centre of Excellence dedicated to advancing research and controlled testbed validation of drone and geospatial analytics.
claims.corrected: Aereo signed an MoU in early 2026 with TEXMiN at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to establish the TEXMiN – Aereo Aerial Intelligence in Mining-CoE (TAaIM) dedicated to advancing research and controlled testbed validation of drone and geospatial analytics.

claims.claim: Aereo (formerly Aarav Unmanned Systems) secured a $1 million contract from Coal India Limited (CIL) to provide drone solutions, including advanced analytics and indigenous survey-grade PPK drones, across 7 major open-cast mines in Northern Coalfields Limited and South Eastern Coalfields.
claims.source: Bots & Drones, BusinessWorld, Geospatial World, and Manufacturing Today reports regarding Aereo's Coal India contract.

claims.claim: The company reports a long-term engagement with Tata Steel since 2019 to conduct aerial surveys for 27 mines, alongside mapping over 40,000–45,000 villages under the government's SVAMITVA scheme.
claims.source: Inc42 Series B funding coverage and Entrackr reports detailing Aereo's long-term partnership with Tata Steel and village mapping count under the SVAMITVA scheme.

claims.claim: In FY24, the company recorded total operational revenue of ₹59.7 Cr, growing 13.6% from ₹52.6 Cr in FY23.
claims.source: Inc42 company financial dataset for Aereo detailing its FY24 financial performance metrics.

claims.claim: The company reports that its sector-specific aerial intelligence and asset management solutions drove a 400% revenue growth over a prior two-year period, alongside achieving profitability at the EBITDA level.
claims.source: Moneycontrol interview with Aereo's CEO confirming EBITDA positivity alongside the official Series B press releases detailing the 400% revenue growth over the two-year timeline.

claims.claim: The company reports having mapped over 45,000 villages under the SVAMITVA scheme, the entire state of Haryana (28,000 square kilometers completed in 14 months), and conducted a large-scale land parcel mapping project in Karnataka covering 86,000 square kilometers across 10 districts.
claims.source: Financial Express overview of Aereo's industrial drone operations covering Haryana and The New Indian Express coverage of the large-scale Karnataka land mapping project.

claims.claim: The company reports having mapped over 150 industrial areas and executed more than 80 plant surveys, along with a 3-year contract to digitize 7 major open-cast mines across Northern Coalfields Limited and South Eastern Coalfields under Coal India Limited.

The company announced a strategic alliance with Seed Group in March 2025 to scale its drone technology, aerial intelligence, and AI analytics platforms across smart cities, infrastructure, and mining sectors in the UAE and the MENA region.

The company reports active commercial and deployment partnerships with national and industrial entities, including conducting aerial mapping projects for the Survey of India (SVAMITVA scheme) and long-term asset surveys with enterprise clients like Tata Steel (since 2019) and Coal India Limited (Digicoal initiative).
The company reports it has mapped over 40,000 villages under the government's SVAMITVA large-scale rural mapping scheme.
The company reports it has mapped a cumulative total of more than 150,000 square kilometres of territory across its operational verticals.

status.main_product: Land surveying and civil consultancy services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone surveying and aerial mapping services under its own name as part of its multi-disciplinary surveying offerings.
status.evidence: According to the company's website, Yogeshwar Associates Pvt. Ltd. delivers drone and aerial surveying services using survey-grade UAVs.

claims.claim: Yogeshwar Associates Pvt. Ltd. reports using Survey-of-India-approved ideaForge RYNO drones equipped with a PPK workflow to capture high-resolution imagery and photogrammetry data yielding under 5cm X/Y accuracy.

Yogeshwar Associates Pvt. Ltd. utilizes Agisoft Metashape software in its drone survey workflow to process raw aerial data, generating orthomosaics, digital surface models (DSM), and dense point clouds.
The company reports utilizing Agisoft Metashape for post-processing drone data in a waste heap volumetric survey project supporting bio-mining operations in Maharashtra, India.
The company reports working to under 5 cm X/Y horizontal accuracy at 60 meters above ground level (AGL) by combining a post-processed kinematic (PPK) workflow with ground control observations.
The company utilizes an ideaForge RYNO micro-class drone approved by the Survey of India to execute photogrammetry workflows, high-resolution orthomosaics, and dense point cloud generations.

The company utilizes the Survey of India-approved ideaForge RYNO drone, establishing a PPK photogrammetry workflow that maps up to 700 acres per day with a flight endurance of up to 40 minutes per mission.
claims.note: flight endurance of up to 40 minutes per mission

claims.claim: The company reports a total broad-entity turnover in the range of ₹1 Crore to ₹5 Crores, but it does not separate or break out its revenue figures specifically for the drone surveying and LiDAR mapping business segment.
The company reports execution of recurring multi-city drone municipal solid waste volumetric survey cycles spanning Pune, Kochi, Lucknow, Delhi, and Lonavala between 2023 and 2025.
The company utilizes Survey-of-India-approved ideaForge RYNO drones equipped with PPK workflows for its aerial mapping and volumetric survey operations.
The company reports operating a fleet including the ideaForge RYNO, a Survey-of-India-approved micro drone, to deliver survey-grade photogrammetry workflows.
